name: Behringer DeepMind 12
description: Behringer DeepMind 12 12-voice analog polysynth: every parameter of its manual's NRPN table, sent as 14-bit NRPNs, and read back from the edit buffer.

sources.title: DeepMind 12 User Manual
sources.notes: NRPN table (pages 136 - 139) read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-tables.mjs from M_BE_0722-AAA_DeepMind-12_WW.pdf (sha256 57ef737bad4d1c16ec079f6bb5c91f0d714ac24498d2303e9e6e2c44dbce2e9f), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/6957166d970349898f7b7699d5407a5e/M_BE_0722-AAA_DeepMind-12_WW.pdf; the edit buffer request and dump from its SysEx chapter. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN table, sent as that NRPN with a 14-bit value (CC 6, then CC 38), and read back from the edit buffer, where it is the byte its 14-bit number gives. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The manual says 242 bytes are packed into 278; 278 bytes carry 243, so 243 are unpacked and the last, which the table does not list, is not read. The packing (`Packed MS bit`) is read with the top bit of the first byte of seven in the lowest bit of the eighth, as Korg's identical diagram is; the manual's diagram does not number the bits.

Rows the manual prints wrongly, corrected by the layout: 5 (LFO 1 Mono Mode, printed 0-1: 0-255, as its notes and LFO 2's); 61 (printed VCA Envelope Attack Curve, as 58 is: Release Curve); 70 (printed VCF Envelope Attack Curve, as 67 is: Release Curve); 79 (printed Mod Envelope Attack Curve, as 76 is: Release Curve); 219 (FX 2 Output Gain, printed —: 0-150, as FX 1 and 4); 220 (FX 3 Output Gain, printed —: 0-150, as FX 1 and 4).

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these NRPNs when its MIDI Control mode is NRPN
